name: Brown Beak-sedge
desc: Brown Beak-sedge (Rhynchospora fusca): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 11 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Rhynchospora fusca is a species of sedge belonging to the family Cyperaceae. The native range of R. fusca is Europe, Central and Eastern Canada to Northern Central and Eastern USA.
